summary: ZenaTech, Inc. furnished a Form 6-K on October 7, 2026, disclosing that the company posted an updated investor presentation to its website on October 6, 2026, attached as Exhibit 99.1. No transaction, stake, price per share, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or closing timeline is stated. The filing is a routine foreign-private-issuer current report on Form 6-K, the US analogue of a domestic Form 8-K, covering investor-relations materials; no special-situation event is present and no deal terms can be extracted.
